text:
tara: Quick heads-up: sample-app hit a parity bug — sampler with n_candidates=1 returned `[candidate]` from hosted API and TS SDK strict validator threw.
ben: ugh. hosted or local stub?
yuki: Hosted playground + samplekit e2e. Runtime's collectCandidates now always yields arrays after a refactor.
tara: Python tolerates it, TS strict mode expects object. We should not silently coerce in SDK by default.
ben: Proposal: server contract = always-array (simpler). SDKs add explicit `unwrapSingleCandidate` opt-in flag. Docs updated.
yuki: Also spotted auth-retry middleware double-encoding args on token refresh — turned objects into JSON strings and broke schema checks. Filing RT-2100.
dev-bot: Issue RT-2100 created: https://tickets.internal/RT-2100
tara: Short-term: add e2e that asserts shape for n=1 and an auth-refresh unit test. Medium: docs + opt-in helper. Long: runtime cleanup.
ben: I'll draft the docs and add TS opt-in helper behind an explicit flag.
